guard: No value the interpreter builds may be a thenable: every write of a record member (a literal key or a computed one, in a literal, a spread, a rest pattern, or a member assignment) refuses a callable `then` with L4021, so the host's promise machinery can never adopt a program value in place of the value itself.

mutations.name: the callable-then refusal is dropped, so the record is built and adopted
mutations.expectRed: each refuse a callable `then` with L4021
mutations.completionMarker: ok but identity comparison takes any operands
mutations.cell: a record literal, a member write, and a computed member write each refuse a callable `then` with L4021
mutations.note: Without the refusal the first sub-check's run does not fail, it PENDS: the built record is adopted at the interpreter's own async boundary and nothing ever settles it, which is the hang half of the original defect. The cell races a four-second timer precisely so the mutation produces a red rather than a hang, because a hang grades INCONCLUSIVE and proves nothing.

mutations.name: a member assignment bypasses the refusal and writes `then` directly
mutations.expectRed: each refuse a callable `then` with L4021
mutations.completionMarker: ok but identity comparison takes any operands
mutations.cell: a record literal, a member write, and a computed member write each refuse a callable `then` with L4021
mutations.note: The literal route still refuses, so this mutation redds on the member-write sub-check only: `o.then = fn` builds the thenable silently and the run completes green where the cell expects L4021.
